issues.on_page: Bond Fund 'Transfer out' 47,291 inside Total disbursements 216,174 (p10); received by the Water Fund as 'Transfer from other funds' 47,291 (p12) and counted in business_type.transfers_net

Under the verifier rule (no transfers in spending) this would be an error, so the user's ruling on decision_needed[0] settles it.
